Name: (AT) CL-Lantern
Author: ChooseYourChallenge
Description:
[b][u]Description:[/u][/b]
This mod uses the "Alternative Texture" framework. This mod gives you the option to select textures of various different popular pressure lanterns from yester-year.
[b]
[u]Dependencies:[/u]
[/b]This mod uses the "[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Texture[/url][/b]" framework.[b]

[u]How To Use:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Craft or purchase the wood lamp-post or decorative lantern.
[*]Purchase the paint bucket from Robin.
[*]Place the wood lamp-post or decorative lantern.
[*]Equip the paint bucket and left click on the lamp-post or lantern.
[*]Select the lantern you want from the list of textures.

[/list][b][u]Known Issues:
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Light source is slightly above the lantern. Looks almost like a heat wave above it
[/list](might be ~somewhat~ realistic as these are gas burning lanterns) - Only present on the Wood Lamp-post versions of the textures
[list]
[*]Not all of the lanterns textures are compatible with the Decorative Lantern. Any of the textures that fit in a 16x16px space will be included in the Decorative Lantern textures.
[/list]
[b][u]Suggestions Needed:[/u][/b]
My initial goal for this mod was to add textures that resemble Coleman lanterns to Stardew. Now that I have done this, I want to add more color ways of existing lanterns. As of 1.0.2, the only colors of the lanterns are ones that were actually produced at some point. I also have thought about adding textures that resemble oil lanterns. What lantern or lantern related texture do you want to see added?
